prompt:
A six-panel newspaper comic strip printed in flat colour on off-white paper, TWO ROWS OF THREE panels. The same postwoman — green coat, green flat cap — appears in every panel.

THE RED UMBRELLA: she is holding it open over her head in every THIRD panel, counting panel 2 as the first of them. In the panels in between there is no umbrella anywhere in the panel.

THE BROWN DOG: a brown dog walks beside her in every SECOND panel, counting panel 1 as the first one it appears in. In the other panels there is no dog anywhere in the panel.

Work out for yourself which panels those come to — I am deliberately not listing them, and the two beats are out of step with one another.

Six different stops on her round, a different pose and camera angle each time. No text, no captions, no lettering.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a comic strip: several separate panels, drawn side by side, with the same person appearing in each panel. Ignoring artistic quality and ignoring whether the story is right, does the image DEPICT that — a strip of separate panels with a recurring figure? A comic page, a storyboard or a picture-book strip all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is blank, a single picture with no panels, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.qa: This picture is a comic strip of 6 panels arranged as two rows of three panels. Look at every panel in reading order (the top row left to right, then the bottom row left to right). For EACH panel in that order, report whether the postwoman is carrying an open RED UMBRELLA over her head, or is carrying no umbrella at all. Use only these words: carried, absent. The panels do not have to agree with one another — report what each panel actually shows, one answer per panel, even if the answer repeats or changes from panel to panel. Answer with exactly 6 answers separated by commas, in panel order, and nothing else.
reference.qa2: The picture is a strip of separate drawings arranged as two rows of three panels. Going through them in the top row left to right, then the bottom row left to right order, tell me, for each drawing in turn, whether the postwoman is carrying an open RED UMBRELLA over her head, or is carrying no umbrella at all. Allowed answers: carried, absent. Judge each drawing on its own — two drawings may well disagree, so do not assume the strip is consistent. Reply with exactly 6 comma-separated answers and nothing else.
